brand.description: Brand file path (relative to the project) or `default` for the bundled brand.

brand_bumpers.description: `false`: do not add the brand's `intro` / `outro` around `main`.

chroma.description:
Chroma subsampling of the deliverable: `420` (default, plays everywhere) or `444` (full
color resolution: no fringes on small colored text; not all players support it).

cues.description:
Named points in the voice-over, found in its transcript: `{clocks: "World clocks"}`.
Timeline times (layer `start`/`end`, sfx `at`, clip `end_at`, marker `at`) can refer to
them as `"cue:clocks"`, `"cue:clocks+0.4"` or `"cue:clocks-0.2"`.

default_frame.description: Screen frame for every video clip that has no `frame` of its own.

default_reframe.description: Default geometry for clips whose aspect differs from the target (default `cover`).

fps.description: Timeline fps. Defaults from the target (long-form targets follow the first clip's source).

main.description: Main storyline: clips, with transitions between them.

profile.description:
`screencast`: tuned for screen and terminal recordings (sharper text encoding; frozen
frames are expected, so QA does not warn about them).

strings.description: Strings that text can refer to as `"@key"` (the base language).

target.description: Output target preset (geometry, fps, encoder, safe zones).

variants.description: Named cuts of the edit (`cutline render --variant teaser`); see `Variant`.

watermark.description: `false`: do not draw the brand logo as a watermark.

alpha.description: Asset is expected to carry alpha (validated against probe).

fps.description: Frame rate for image sequences / HTML renders.

kind.description: Auto-detected from ffprobe and the extension when omitted.

params.description: Parameters injected into HTML templates as `window.__cutline_params`.

path.description: Path relative to the project file. Image sequences use a printf pattern (`frames/%05d.png`).

script.description:
The text that was spoken (relative path to a .txt file), e.g. the TTS script. Captions
and cues then use the script's exact words, timed from the transcript.

synthetic.description: Mark this asset as AI-generated (affects the publishing checklist).

transcript.description: Transcript for this asset: Scribe JSON or cutline transcript JSON (relative path).

width.description: Render size for HTML/SVG/Lottie (defaults to the target size).

AudioAlign.description: How an audio layer's asset lines up with the layer span.

oneOf.description:
Backtime: the asset's own ending lands on the layer's end (the start is trimmed, or
the layer starts later when the asset is shorter).

dialogue_chain.description: Chain applied to dialogue (main clip audio); default same as voice_chain.

micro_fade.description: Micro-fade length at cuts in seconds (default 0.01).

music_level.description:
How far the music sits below the voice, in LU, while ducked (e.g. 18). The music gain
is measured and set at render time, replacing trial-and-error with `gain_db`.

voice_chain.description: clean_voice | podcast_warm | raw — applied to voice (VO) assets.

keys.description: Show a `keys` badge for shortcuts and Enter/Escape/Tab presses (default true).

cursor.description: Browser recordings: draw the mouse pointer (with click ripples) and shortcut badges.

fast_forward_idle.description: Play stretches where little changes on screen and nobody speaks at a higher speed.

sfx_on_transitions.description: SFX asset/alias auto-placed on every transition.

snap_to_beats.description: Move cuts onto the music's beats (fitting each clip with `end_at`).

zoom_on_clicks.description: Browser recordings: zoom in on each click and follow from one click to the next.

ByteSize.description: A size in bytes: a number, or a string like `"8MB"`, `"900KB"`, `"1.5GB"` (powers of 1000).

oneOf.description: Transcribe / import transcripts and map words through the edit.
Use `file` (SRT or cutline transcript JSON in timeline time).

assets.description: Asset ids whose transcripts feed captions (default: all clip assets + voice layers).

emoji.description: Emoji to append to emphasis words (word → emoji name).

position.description: lower_mid (default) | center | upper_mid | bottom | top, or {x, y}

size.description: Font size in px at the output resolution.

audio.description: Clip audio: keep (default), mute, duck (−12 dB), or an asset id replacing it.

chapter.description: Chapter title (long form); defaults to the clip id when the clip starts a chapter.

duration.description: Timeline duration for stills / generated assets.

end_at.description:
Timeline time of the cut to the next clip (the middle of the outgoing transition), e.g.
`"cue:calendar"`, `"bar:12"`. The clip is fitted to end there at its `speed` (default
1): footage past the cut is trimmed (an `out` is then only a limit), and footage that
runs out early holds its last frame (`W_FIT_HOLD`). Stills get the duration. Set
`fit: "speed"` to change the speed instead.

except.description: Variants this clip is left out of.

fit.description:
With `end_at`, `in` and `out`: `trim` (default) keeps the speed and trims or holds;
`speed` plays exactly `in`..`out` at whatever speed fills the slot (frame-blended).

frame.description:
Draw the clip inside a window (browser, app window, phone, tablet) on a background,
instead of full-bleed. `zoom_to` rects and annotations stay relative to the recording.

id.description: Unique id (used for anchors, chapters, review output).

only.description: Variants this clip belongs to (default: all).

out.description: Source out point (default: end of the asset).

reverse.description: Play the clip backwards (short clips only).

lut.description: Bundled LUT name or a `.cube` path relative to the project.

Cue.description: A cue: a phrase in a voice track. The short form is just the phrase.

asset.description: Asset whose transcript is searched. Default: the only voice-role audio layer's asset.

edge.description: `start` (default): when the first word begins; `end`: when the last word ends.

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of the phrase (1-based, default 1).

phrase.description: Words to find (case and punctuation are ignored; close transcription slips match).

click.description: A click happens when the pointer arrives here.

oneOf.description: Quick zoom in at `at` (clip-relative seconds), holding until `hold` ends, then optionally out.

focus.description: Zoom focus point in output-normalized coordinates (default center).

hold.description: Seconds to hold the zoom (default: until clip end).

oneOf.description: Continuous zoom from→to across [start, end] (clip-relative).

Zoom so `rect` (fractions of the frame) fills the view, starting at `start`
(clip-relative) over `duration`; zoom back out from `end` if set.

end.description: Clip-relative time to start zooming back out (same duration and ease).

padding.description: Margin around the rect as a fraction of the frame (default 0.03).

oneOf.description: Slow pan+zoom (stills and B-roll).
Hold the frame at `at` (clip-relative) for `duration` seconds (extends the clip).

captions.description: `burn` (default: captions in the picture), `sidecar` (only the .srt/.vtt files) or `none`.

chroma.description: Overrides the project's `chroma` for this export.

loop.description:
`true`: make the video loop seamlessly (its end dissolves into its start; the export is
half a second shorter). Needs `audio: false`.

max_bytes.description: Largest file size, e.g. `"8MB"`, `"900KB"` or bytes. The bitrate is solved for it.

name.description: Export name (used in the output file name). Defaults to the target name.

out.description: Output path (relative to the project). Default `out/<name>.mp4` (or `.webm`).

poster.description: Time on the edit of the poster frame written next to the video (default 0.5 s).

range.description: Export only this part of the edit: `[from, to]` (times on the edit; cues allowed).

activity.description:
Share of the picture that may change per tenth of a second and still count as idle
(default 0.006: typing, a spinner or a blinking caret).

applies_to.description: Asset ids (default: every video clip asset).

badge.description: Show a small speed badge ("4×") while fast-forwarding (default true).

keep.description: Seconds kept at normal speed at each end of an idle stretch (default 0.4).

min_idle.description: Shortest idle stretch worth speeding up, in seconds (default 2.5).

speed.description: Playback speed of idle stretches (default 4; up to 8).

Fps.description: Frames per second: number (30, 29.97) or rational string "30000/1001".

anyOf.description: `brand`, a color (`#101014`) or an image asset id.

oneOf.description: Title bar with an address field.
Title bar with a title.
Rounded bezel, portrait recordings.
No chrome: just rounded corners, shadow and background.
No frame at all (opts a clip out of `default_frame`).

Text template (hook_title, lower_third, callout, step_counter, big_number, quote,
cta_subscribe, end_card, emoji_pop).

`brand` (default: the brand background), a color, `{gradient: [from, to]}`, or the id
of an image asset.

padding.description: Space around the window as a fraction of the frame's shorter side (default 0.06).

radius.description: Corner radius in output px (default 14 at 1080p; phones and tablets have their own).

asset.description: Asset whose beats are used (default: the only music-role audio layer's asset).

downbeat_reach.description:
A cut within this many seconds of the first beat of a bar goes there rather than to a
nearer weak beat (default 0.35; 0 treats all beats alike). Used when the bars are clear.

max_shift.description: Largest move of a cut, in seconds (default 0.15). Cuts farther from a beat stay put.

t.description: Source-relative time (seconds from the clip's in point).

oneOf.description: 1080×1350 feed video (LinkedIn, Instagram).

TimeValue.description: Seconds (number), timecode string "mm:ss.mmm" / "hh:mm:ss.mmm", frames "f:N", "end", or (timeline times only) a cue reference "cue:name" / "cue:name+0.5".

audio.description: Audio behaviour: crossfade (default) or cut (hard cut with micro-fades).

color.description: Flash/fill color for flash_cut and similar.

ease.description:
Progress curve. Default: `in_out_cubic` for moving transitions (slides, covers, whips,
zooms), `in_out_quad` for the rest (fades, wipes); `linear` for a constant rate.
`back` and `spring` are not allowed (progress must not run backwards).

sfx.description: SFX asset id or brand alias played at the transition midpoint.

type.description:
xfade name (fade, wipeleft, slideup, circleopen, …) or custom: whip_left/right/up/down,
zoom_punch, flash_cut, glitch, cut.

Variant.description: A cut of the edit. Clips and layers also choose their variants with `only` / `except`.

assets.description: Asset fields to replace, by asset id: `{vo: {path: "vo.teaser.mp3", script: "vo.teaser.txt"}}`.

exports.description: Export names to render for this variant (default: all).

max_duration.description: Warn when this variant runs longer (seconds).

hold.description: Seconds the zoom stays after the last click of a group (default 1.2).

merge_within.description: Clicks closer together than this many seconds share one zoom (default 2.5).

steps.description: Only these step names (default: every click and typed field).
